sources.notes: Preferred source if it agrees (D-07). Still needs permission: robots allowing crawling is not a licence to republish (PRD). Audit: cinema and day pages are static HTML with the times in the page. No fixture committed: waiting for the reply to the 11 Nov email.

permission.summary: Asked by email to onlinesupport@filmhouseng.com from Chimezie on 11 Nov 2026. No reply yet.

sources.notes: Booking URL pattern: /movies/<film>/showtimes/<date>/<site>/select-tickets?showtime=<id>. robots.txt could not be read on 6 Nov. 11 Nov: robots.txt read at www.filmhouseng.com. Public pages are allowed, but /api/ and every /select-tickets page are disallowed, so we may link to a booking page but never fetch one. The home page HTML carries no showtimes (drawn by script); if the times come from /api/, they are off limits without permission. Contact addresses on the home page: onlinesupport@filmhouseng.com, sales@filmhouseng.com. Audit: the film page and the showtimes page (/movies/whalefall-2026/showtimes/2026-11-11?location=all) are skeletons with no times and no booking links in the HTML; the times load in the browser after the page opens. That data path is not readable under robots.txt (/api/ is disallowed), so Filmhouse needs a yes or a feed. No fixture possible.

These are the terms of silverbirdcinemas.com; the Veezi sessions page itself shows no terms.

sources.notes: Veezi sessions pages per site token. 11 Nov: Veezi /sessions/ pages are server-rendered and not disallowed; /purchase/ pages are disallowed, so link to them but never fetch them. The Galleria page still says "No shows currently scheduled". Silverbird Ikeja's site token is not recorded yet. Silverbird's own site carries the use=reference content signal. Audit: the Ikeja page is server-rendered with the full programme for today and tomorrow (70 times on 11 Nov) plus a few advance dates. Dates carry no year ("Wednesday 11, November") and times are 12-hour ("10:40 AM"); the parser must add the year from the fetch date. Fixture: tests/fixtures/silverbird/2026-11-11-ikeja.html (cut down, D-24). Silverbird's own terms forbid copying its content and linking to its site without written permission, so treat Silverbird as needing a written yes even though Veezi's robots.txt allows the page (O-12).
